result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a misspelled search placeholder, inconsistent favorite-icon styling, and clipped carousel content with truncated text.

issues.description: Search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' - 'Restaurants' is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: Favorite heart buttons in 'Popular right now' section are inconsistent: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a bare white outline with no background, while the pizza card below shows the heart inside a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent treatment for all favorite buttons, e.g., white icon inside a dark translucent circular scrim for contrast and visibility.

issues.description: Right-edge carousel content is clipped mid-element: the far-right filter pill and the third 'Fastest near you' card are cut off, leaving the restaurant name as 'Trattoria Piccol' cut mid-letter.
issues.suggestion: Add list end-padding and use proper text truncation with ellipsis so clipped carousel items do not look broken.
